Here is the customized prompt tailored to the context of software developers working with outdated technology, designed to encourage embracing new tech and continuous learning:

"Given the rapid pace of change in the software development industry, how can a team currently relying on outdated technology effectively transition to modern tools and practices? Please provide a strategic approach that emphasizes the importance of continuous learning, upskilling, and adopting new technologies to remain competitive and efficient in this fast-evolving field."
